title: Umnikelo Owashintsha Ikusasa
intro: Ezinsukwini zokuqala zesintu, umphefumulo wawunikela ngesipho ngezinhloso ezimsulwa. Noma kunjalo, umona wawucashe emthunzini wokwamukelwa. Thola indaba yalesi sibalo esinobungcwele nesiphetho esibuhlungu esingenakufa esambulweni saphezulu.
clues: Nganikela umnikelo eNkosini yami, futhi wamukelwa ngomusa.
Umnikelo womfowethu wenqatshwa, futhi umona wamnyama inhliziyo yakhe.
Ngathi kuye, 'Uma welula isandla sakho kimi ukuze ungibulale, ngeke ngilule isandla sami ukuze ngikubulale; impela ngiyamesaba u-Allah, iNkosi yezwe.'
Ngaba yisisulu sesenzo sokuqala sokubulala emhlabeni.
Igazi lami lakhala, futhi ngangingumfel’ ukholo wokuqala ongenacala.

trial.label: Isivivinyo/Umcimbi
options: Umnikelo wakhe wamukelwa, okwabangela umona womfowabo nokubulawa kwakhe
Waphonswa esithandweni somlilo ovuthayo kodwa waphuma engenamyocu
Wakha umkhumbi omkhulu ngaphansi kwesiqondiso saphezulu

outcome.label: Umphumela

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
